title: DR1 opens identification details with a Selected commodities table and an 'Add another commodity' link; the frontend goes straight into the first animal's fields.

finding.frontend: Below the inset warning the page drops straight to the first commodity heading and its entry form. A person part-way through identifying animals cannot see what the consignment holds, cannot correct a commodity from here, and cannot add another one — the only route back is the Back link or the hub. The template renders the inset and then the cards with nothing between them (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/animal-identification.njk:9-23).
finding.prototype: DR1 puts a block headed 'Selected commodities' between the inset text and the first panel. It is a four-column table — Commodity code, Common name, Number of animals, and a Change link on each row that returns to the commodity search — followed by an 'Add another commodity' link (app/views/animal-identification-details.html:55-83). It gives the person the whole consignment at a glance and two ways to correct it without leaving the page.
finding.difference: Add the block above the identification cards: a heading, one row per commodity line showing the line's code, common name and number of animals, a Change link per row back to the commodity search, and an 'Add another commodity' link below the table. The row data is already on the page — every card is built from the same commodityLines collection — so this is a view-model and template addition with no new answers collected. Note the frontend's commodity picker is a fixed checkbox list rather than a search, so the Change link's destination is the commodity page, not a search reset.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a selected-commodities summary, or an 'Add another commodity' link, rendered anywhere on the frontend's animal identification page.
finding.correction: Sound, observed on both sides. The DR1 block is in the screenshot and its two links resolve in the captured DOM — Change to /what-are-you-importing?resetSearch=1 and Add another commodity to /what-are-you-importing — and the frontend page goes from the inset straight to the first card with nothing between. One thing worth adding for whoever builds it: the frontend already renders this block, with the same heading and the same three columns, on its consignment-details page (copy at commodities/copy/copy.en.js:20-30), so the work is repeating an existing pattern on a second page rather than designing one. Kept split from identification--change-number-of-animals-link, which the previous run carried as one increment with this: they are two additions in two places on the page, and either can land without the other.

relatedTo.why: both restore a route out of the identification page back to the commodity answers
